limits: Exact native spiderB / enSpiderB / renderer 121386 source assignment only; no Spider A renderer, sibling chassis, material route, or topology receives credit from this record.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced health from 63 to 59; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Eighteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 342 captured frames and generated videos are retained evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture drives the native Death animation into an intact airborne pose and a coherent collapsed custom-mesh corpse that remains sampled behind the loot overlay; it does not establish ordinary lethal behavior or corpse lifetime after the sampled interval.

The causal Damaged and Death impact frames are strongly occluded by the foreground hero and bright effects; recovery, airborne death, collapse, and final corpse frames remain readable, and no sampled tearing, detached leg segment, missing surface, floor clipping, or viewport clipping was observed.

Indirect death, other native attack variants, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
